legend: Let's call two strings s$$$s$$$ and t$$$t$$$ anagrams of each other if it is possible to rearrange symbols in the string s$$$s$$$ to get a string, equal to t$$$t$$$.

Let's consider two strings s$$$s$$$ and t$$$t$$$ which are anagrams of each other. We say that t$$$t$$$ is a reducible anagram of s$$$s$$$ if there exists an integer k≥2$$$k \ge 2$$$ and 2k$$$2k$$$ non-empty strings s1,t1,s2,t2,…,sk,tk$$$s_1, t_1, s_2, t_2, \dots, s_k, t_k$$$ that satisfy the following conditions:
If we write the strings s1,s2,…,sk$$$s_1, s_2, \dots, s_k$$$ in order, the resulting string will be equal to s$$$s$$$;
If we write the strings t1,t2,…,tk$$$t_1, t_2, \dots, t_k$$$ in order, the resulting string will be equal to t$$$t$$$;
For all integers i$$$i$$$ between 1$$$1$$$ and k$$$k$$$ inclusive, si$$$s_i$$$ and ti$$$t_i$$$ are anagrams of each other.
If such strings don't exist, then t$$$t$$$ is said to be an irreducible anagram of s$$$s$$$. Note that these notions are only defined when s$$$s$$$ and t$$$t$$$ are anagrams of each other.

For example, consider the string s=$$$s = $$$ "gamegame". Then the string t=$$$t = $$$ "megamage" is a reducible anagram of s$$$s$$$, we may choose for example s1=$$$s_1 = $$$ "game", s2=$$$s_2 = $$$ "gam", s3=$$$s_3 = $$$ "e" and t1=$$$t_1 = $$$ "mega", t2=$$$t_2 = $$$ "mag", t3=$$$t_3 = $$$ "e":
On the other hand, we can prove that t=$$$t = $$$ "memegaga" is an irreducible anagram of s$$$s$$$.

You will be given a string s$$$s$$$ and q$$$q$$$ queries, represented by two integers 1≤l≤r≤|s|$$$1 \le l \le r \le |s|$$$ (where |s|$$$|s|$$$ is equal to the length of the string s$$$s$$$). For each query, you should find if the substring of s$$$s$$$ formed by characters from the l$$$l$$$-th to the r$$$r$$$-th has at least one irreducible anagram.
input: The first line contains a string s$$$s$$$, consisting of lowercase English characters (1≤|s|≤2⋅105$$$1 \le |s| \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$).
The second line contains a single integer q$$$q$$$ (1≤q≤105$$$1 \le q \le 10^5$$$)  — the number of queries.

Each of the following q$$$q$$$ lines contain two integers l$$$l$$$ and r$$$r$$$ (1≤l≤r≤|s|$$$1 \le l \le r \le |s|$$$), representing a query for the substring of s$$$s$$$ formed by characters from the l$$$l$$$-th to the r$$$r$$$-th.
output: For each query, print a single line containing "Yes" (without quotes) if the corresponding substring has at least one irreducible anagram, and a single line containing "No" (without quotes) otherwise.
note: In the first sample, in the first and third queries, the substring is "a", which has itself as an irreducible anagram since two or more non-empty strings cannot be put together to obtain "a". On the other hand, in the second query, the substring is "aaa", which has no irreducible anagrams: its only anagram is itself, and we may choose s1=$$$s_1 = $$$ "a", s2=$$$s_2 = $$$ "aa", t1=$$$t_1 = $$$ "a", t2=$$$t_2 = $$$ "aa" to show that it is a reducible anagram.
In the second query of the second sample, the substring is "abb", which has, for example, "bba" as an irreducible anagram.

legend.ai: 如果可以重新排列字符串 s$$$s$$$ 中的符号，得到一个与 t$$$t$$$ 相等的字符串，那么称字符串 s$$$s$$$ 和 t$$$t$$$ 互为字谜。
考虑两个互为字谜的字符串 s$$$s$$$ 和 t$$$t$$$。如果存在一个整数 k≥2$$$k \ge 2$$$，以及 2k$$$2k$$$ 个非空字符串 s1,t1,s2,t2,…,sk,tk$$$s_1, t_1, s_2, t_2, \dots, s_k, t_k$$$，满足以下条件，则称 t$$$t$$$ 是 s$$$s$$$ 的可约字谜：
如果我们按顺序将字符串 s1、s2、…、sk$$$s_1, s_2, \dots, s_k$$$ 拼接起来，得到的字符串将等于 s$$$s$$$；
如果我们按顺序将字符串 t1、t2、…、tk$$$t_1, t_2, \dots, t_k$$$ 拼接起来，得到的字符串将等于 t$$$t$$$；
对于所有介于 1$$$1$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$(含)之间的整数 i$$$i$$$，si$$$s_i$$$ 和 ti$$$t_i$$$ 互为字母异位词。
如果不存在这样的字符串，那么称 t$$$t$$$ 是 s$$$s$$$ 的不可约异位词。注意，只有当 s$$$s$$$ 和 t$$$t$$$ 互为字母异位词时，这些概念才有定义。

例如，考虑字符串 s=$$$s = $$$ "gamegame"。那么字符串 t=$$$t = $$$ "megamage" 是 s$$$s$$$ 的可约异位词；例如，我们可以选择 s1=$$$s_1 = $$$ "game"、s2=$$$s_2 = $$$ "gam"、s3=$$$s_3 = $$$ "e"，以及 t1=$$$t_1 = $$$ "mega"、t2=$$$t_2 = $$$ "mag"、t3=$$$t_3 = $$$ "e"：
另一方面，我们可以证明 t=$$$t = $$$“memegaga”是 s$$$s$$$ 的一个不可约重排。
给定一个字符串 s$$$s$$$ 和 q$$$q$$$ 个查询，每个查询由两个整数 1≤l≤r≤|s|$$$1 \le l \le r \le |s|$$$ 表示(其中 |s|$$$|s|$$$ 等于字符串 s$$$s$$$ 的长度)。对于每个查询，你需要判断由 s$$$s$$$ 中第 l$$$l$$$ 个字符到第 r$$$r$$$ 个字符组成的子串是否至少存在一个不可约重排。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个字符串 s$$$s$$$，由小写英文字母组成(1≤|s|≤2⋅105$$$1 \le |s| \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)。
第二行包含一个整数 q$$$q$$$(1≤q≤105$$$1 \le q \le 10^5$$$)，表示查询的数量。
接下来的 q$$$q$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 l$$$l$$$ 和 r$$$r$$$(1≤l≤r≤|s|$$$1 \le l \le r \le |s|$$$)，表示对由 s$$$s$$$ 中第 l$$$l$$$ 个字符到第 r$$$r$$$ 个字符组成的子串的查询。

output.ai: 对于每个查询，输出一行。如果对应的子串至少存在一个不可约重排，则输出“Yes”（不含引号）；否则输出“No”（不含引号）。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，在第一个和第三个查询里，子串为 "a"。它本身就是一个不可约异位词，因为无法将两个或更多非空字符串拼接起来得到 "a"。另一方面，在第二个查询中，子串为 "aaa"，它没有不可约异位词：它唯一的异位词就是自身，并且我们可以选择 s1=$$$s_1 = $$$ "a"、s2=$$$s_2 = $$$ "aa"、t1=$$$t_1 = $$$ "a"、t2=$$$t_2 = $$$ "aa"，以说明它是一个可约异位词。
在第二个样例的第二个查询中，子串为 "abb"，例如，"bba" 就是它的一个不可约异位词。
